text:
cheng: heads-up — I'm bringing up fusehead-7b (fp16 -> int4) on staging. baseline FP16 perplexity looks fine, int4 shows weird token shifts and large accuracy drop.
maria: :eyes: what's the delta? quick numbers pls
cheng: hellaswag acc FP16 58.2%, int4 33.7% (same prompts). top1 token diff ~41%.
devin: whoa. that smells like a proj/rotary ordering mismatch or head grouping. fusehead docs mention hybrid head concat. did the converter assume headwise?
alex: yep, most converters default to (num_heads, head_dim) but some models export (head_dim, num_heads) or interleave. try forcing proj_order explicitly.
cheng: repro snippet I used: 
```
# conversion command
python tools/convert_model.py \
  --src_format=hf \
  --dst_format=redwood \
  --model=fusehead-7b \
  --quant=int4 \
  --proj_order=auto
```
cheng: short eval log: 
```
[eval] hellaswag acc: 33.7 vs fp16 58.2
[top1_diff] 0.412
```
maria: try `--proj_order=headwise` and also experiment with a `--rotary-offset` param, sometimes headgroups are shifted by a small constant.
devin: helper loop to scan offsets quickly: 
```
for off in range(4):
  python tools/headmap_check.py --offset $off --model converted.bin --testset hellaswag
```
alex: I ran that on my dev VM earlier — offset=2 bumped hellaswag to 55.8%. suggests a headgroup rotation by 2.
cheng: confirmed here: offset=2 + per-head asymmetric quant calibration => 56.1%. not perfect but close to FP16.
triage-bot: issue RED-842 created: "fusehead-7b int4 proj/rotary head_offset mismatch" (severity: medium)
maria: nice find. action items: (1) add head_offset autodetect in convert pipeline; (2) add unit test that compares per-head top1/token-diff to baseline; (3) run full eval suite (6 benchmarks) on the corrected build.
cheng: I'll open a PR with an autodetect heuristic (scan offsets 0..3 compute per-head cross-entropy delta) + a small bench wrapper. target: Mon EOD.
devin: also include metadata in the converted artifact: {"head_offset": n, "proj_order": "headwise|interleaved"} so Console can show what we used.
alex: adding checklist item for rollout docs and a short note about how this interacts with KV-cache indexing.
cheng: thanks — dropping full logs and the small repro in the PR description. will ping when ready.
